svg.title: Latent Diffusion Model (Text-to-Image)
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the original figure. Base frames include the training label/frame areas, U-Net, sampling denoising panel, lower diffusion panels, legend, and key components panel. Object mappings established for SAM replacement: input landscape photo draft_input_photo to asset_sam_region_000055; generated landscape draft_generated_photo to asset_sam_region_000056; frozen snowflake icons draft_snow_encoder/draft_snow_text/draft_snow_decoder/draft_legend_snow to assets 000050/000051/000053/000048; legend CA/conv/bottleneck icons to assets 000054/000049/000052. Non-SAM diagram content is retained as native SVG.

g.desc: Pretrained Autoencoder Encoder is a trapezoid right of input image; snowflake at upper-left indicates frozen pretrained module.

Inside f02, blue encoder/decoder convolution blocks form a symmetric U-Net around a central bottleneck; purple CA blocks are on the down/up paths; gray dashed skip connections cross the top; purple dashed conditioning arrows rise from text embeddings to CA blocks.

svg.text: Add noise gradually according to q(zt | zt−1)
Remove noise iteratively using learned εθ
Latent Space: Operates in a compact latent space for efficiency.
Conditioning: Text embeddings guide generation via cross-attention.
Denoising U-Net: Predicts noise conditioned on text and timestep.
Autoencoder Decoder: Maps denoised latent back to image space.
